capabilities: Scan all notes for Markdown todo items
Track daily work on a task board with multiple statuses
Plan tasks by due date using natural language dates
Generate daily and date-range work reports
Customize attributes, folders, and display options
extras: Supports optional Dataview syntax and wikilink-based due dates for daily notes; README includes troubleshooting and large-vault performance tips.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see and manage todos scattered across all notes from a single board with statuses, due dates, and day planning.

relations.evidence: If you prefer Dataview syntax, you can enable it in settings

summary: Task manager that scans all notes for Markdown todos and organizes them on a daily task board with planning panels and work reports.
